prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1110; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left quarter panel shows a crease with paint loss, which matches the rear-end impact described in the claim. The trunk lid lock assembly and tail lamp housing also show deformation consistent with the force of the collision. Our plan is to replace the bumper cover, repair and refinish the quarter panel, and install a new tail lamp assembly. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage, and the parts list contains no duplicated line items. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the records reviewed.
